The '''South Pedestrian Bridge''' was a bridge in the city of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. One of the legs of the [[Keren Street Race]] circuit led across the bridge.<ref name="SWG:KSR" />

==History==
[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops used the bridge to access the city during the [[Invasion of Keren]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:GU15">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Game Update 15: Galactic Civil War: Forces Under Siege</ref>
